subject: health
concept: Understanding the major food groups and that a balanced plate includes a mix of them
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student builds a balanced plate using real or play food models across the major food groups
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a meal to whether it reflects a balanced mix of food groups
exercise.abstract: Student explains why a balanced plate includes a mix of food groups rather than just one

misconception_flags: labels a specific food group as entirely 'bad' rather than focusing on overall balance

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
